scope: Corollary 7.1 of the manuscript “Integral Donovan Finiteness over Witt Vectors” (preprints/Integral-Donovan-Finiteness-over-Witt-Vectors-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 203 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ab8478191fa023af), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every p, M, there is a finite list of integral basic orders R′ 1, . . . , R′ v such that the basic algebra of every block of kG of defect order at most M is isomorphic to k ⊗O R′ i for some i. In particular the blocks over k of bounded defect have finitely many k-linear Morita classes.
